content: मारः [मृ-घञ्] .²1 Killing, slaughter, slaying; अशेषप्राणिनामासीदमारो दश वत्सरान् <ls>Rāj. T. 5. 64</ls>. .²2 An obstacle, hindrance, opposition. .²3 The god of love; श्यामात्मा कुटिलः करोतु कबरीभारोपि मारोद्यमम् <ls>Gīt. 3</ls>; (where मार primarily means ‘killing’); <ls>Nāg. 1. 1</ls>. .²4 Love, passion. .²5 The thorn-apple (धत्तूर). .²6 An evil one, a destroyer; the tempter (according to Buddhists); सेर्ष्यं मारवधूभिरित्यभिहितो बोधौ जिनः पातु वः <ls>Nāg. 1. 1</ls>; <ls>Pt. 5. 14</ls>. .²7 Death.
